info.title: Soul Buster
info.synopsis: Ispirata al classico cinese “Il Romanzo Dei Tre Regni”, la storia è ambientata nella moderna Cina, in cui è possibile evocare personaggi storici o di romanzi famosi tramite apposite carde. Il protagonista, il liceale Son Shin, durante un sogno rompe un sigillo che inizia a cancellare l’epoca degli stati combattenti, trovandosi al centro di una lotta tra i tre regni. Al suo fianco c’è Zhou Yu, ex generale dell’epoca, legato da qualche destino misterioso a Son Shin.

info.title: Lupin III - Viaggio nel pericolo (ITA)
info.synopsis: L'ispettore Zenigata viene esonerato dall'incarico di catturare Lupin perchè non ne è ritenuto all'altezza. Viene assunta quindi una nuova ispettrice di nome Keith, intenzionata a catturarlo, non importa se vivo o morto. Il celebre ladro, infastidito da quest'insolita siuazione, vuole far tornare Zazà alle sue vecchie mansioni, approfittando di un nuovo caso riguardante il traffico di armi da parte di un'organizzazione chiamata Shot Shell. Con l'aiuto di Jigen, porta a termine il furto di un sottomarino russo per poi venderlo all'organizzazione. Per guidare il sottomarino occorre necessariamente una mano esperta, quindi chi meglio della sua stessa creatrice? Rapiscono così l'astrofisica russa, mente del progetto, e le fanno pilotare il sottomarino. In seguito, John Cloths, il capo della Shot Shell, incontra Lupin, che assume come suo dipendente. Ma il ladro è intenzionato soltanto a mettere le mani sul suo denaro, cosa che lo stesso Cloths sospetta da tempo. Ma cosa più importante: riuscirà a ridare a Zenigata il suo vecchio incarico, senza essere catturato dall'agguerrita agente?

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata has been removed from the Lupin case which leaves him despondent, and he ends up drinking with Lupin & Jigen. Lupin decides that he and his gang should work with Zenigata to solve his new case, investigating a group of arms dealers known as Shot Shell. Lupin gathers his partners together (Jigen, Goemon, & Fujiko), and with Zenegata they steal a Russian submarine. They kidnap a scientist named Karen Korinsky to help them operate the sub, and also to protect her from Shot Shell. Meanwhile the ICPO assigns a man named Keith Hayden to the Lupin case, and unlike Zenigata he wants Lupin and his group dead. Where ever Lupin and friends go, Keith follows, as the officer attempts to pick them off one by one.

info.title: Sailor Moon
info.synopsis: Siamo in Giappone, all’inizio degli anni Novanta. Usagi Tsukino è una normalissima ragazza che frequenta la seconda media all’istituto Juuban. Una mattina Usagi incontra una gattina nera con un cerotto sulla fronte; la ragazza, presa la gattina, le toglie il cerotto, ma la gattina la graffia e scappa via. Usagi, arrivata in classe in ritardo, viene rimproverata dalla professoressa Aruna, che si lamenta con lei anche del suo scarso rendimento scolastico. Uscita da scuola Usagi, depressa per il risultato del compito in classe e avendo paura di mostrarlo alla madre, accartoccia il foglio e lo getta via. Il foglio cade in testa ad un affascinante ragazzo che non appena visto il voto prende in giro la giovane. Usagi infuriata gli strappa il foglio di mano e allontanandosi gli dice di farsi i fatti propri. Tornata a casa Usagi viene rimproverata anche da sua madre per il voto disastroso che ha preso nel compito in classe, appena 30/100. Salita in camera propria Usagi si stende esausta sul letto ma proprio in quel momento la gattina nera entra dalla finestra presentandosi come Luna e annunciandole di averla scelta per combattere i nemici del Dark Kingdom, guidati dalla perfida Queen Beryl che insieme ai suoi quattro generali ha intenzione di invadere la terra e rubare agli uomini l’energia vitale che le occorre per risvegliare Queen Metallia, che giace addormentata da secoli.

episodes.title: Una guerriera speciale
episodes.synopsis:
Usagi Tsukino è una normale ragazza giapponese che frequenta la seconda media, piagnucolosa e un po' goffa, come lei stessa ammette, la cui vita subisce un cambiamento radicale il giorno in cui incontra una gatta parlante di nome Luna. Questa le spiega che lei è destinata a diventare una delle Guerriere Sailor paladine della giustizia, per salvare il mondo dalle forze del male e al contempo trovare le sue compagne e la Princess.

La sua prima missione risulta esser quella di aiutare la sua migliore amica Naru Osaka, e sua madre proprietaria di un negozio di gioielleria; impara così ad utilizzare i suoi nuovi poteri per combattere i nemici in battaglia, che vogliono impossessarsi dell'energia (energia vitale nell'adattamento italiano) degli esseri umani. Ma ecco che nel momento di maggior difficoltà viene salvata dal misterioso Tuxedo Kamen abbigliato in smoking e cilindro, di cui immediatamente s'innamora.

episodes.title: Vedo e prevedo
episodes.synopsis:
La Queen Beryl del Dark Kingdom manda il suo servitore Jadeite sulla Terra a raccogliere l'energia degli esseri umani, questo per poter risvegliare dal suo sonno la grande Queen Metaria. Questi tramite un negozio di cartomanzia attira ed inganna un gran numero di persone desiderose di andar a farsi legger la mano e conoscer il proprio futuro, e mediante l'uso della carta del diavolo li rende servitori del male e ad essi ordina di esaudire ogni loro desiderio

Dopo aver osservato lo strano comportamento di alcuni dei suoi amici, tra cui Umino Gurio, che vi si sono recati, Usagi si rende conto che sta succedendo qualcosa di strano e si reca, col supporto di Luna, ad indagare.

episodes.title: Lettere d'amore
episodes.synopsis:
Ora Jadeite raccoglie l'energia umana attraverso una spilla a forma di fiore, la flower brooch, che viene consegnata in regalo per posta a coloro le cui lettere d'amore vengono scelte per esser lette al programma Midnight Zero ("Mezzanotte lettere d'amore in diretta" nell'adattamento italiano) dalla stazione radio FM no.10; una delle prime vittime è la professoressa d'inglese di Usagi, Haruna Sakurada, e poi la stessa Naru. Luna scopre il pericolo e convince Usagi ad indagare

Trasformatasi grazie alla "penna magica", la penna del cambiamento (penna lunare nell'adattamento italiano) in una conduttrice radiofonica e riesce ad entrare nella stazione radio: dopo essersi trasformata in Sailor Moon si troverà a dover combattere contro Jadeite; per fortuna proprio nel momento in cui si trova più in pericolo compare Tuxedo Kamen ad aiutarla come al solito.

episodes.title: Cura dimagrante
episodes.synopsis:
Usagi è ingrassata di qualche chilo e gli è venuta l'ossessione del peso. Jadeite apre una palestra (palestra con salone di bellezza nell'adattamento italiano), la Shapely (Beauty Gym nell'adattamento italiano), che si occupa principalmente di far perdere peso in brevissimo tempo; in realtà si tratta d'una trappola appositamente escogitata per attrarre le persone in speciali capsule e rubargli in tal modo l'energia mediante i raggi Shape (raggi rinvigorenti nell'adattamento italiano).

Usagi e gle sue amiche decidono di entrar in questa palestra attirate dalla prova gratuita e per vedere come ha fatto la loro insegnante a perder molto di peso in un giorno solo; Usagi dopo esser fuggita, scoraggiata dalla troppa fatica, tornerò successivamente, pentita, con Luna insieme a Luna e quest'ultima, vedendo la Professoressa Haruna molto debilitata la segue e scopre le capsule. Convinta Usagi a seguirla, e a trasformarsi in Sailor Moon, si confrontano con Jadeite, il quale però stavolta riesce a fuggire dopo aver fatto raccolto una grande quantità d'energia umana, lasciando però Sailor Moon lottare contro gli allenatori della palestra da lui controllati. Gli allenatori controllati mediante un diadema attaccano Sailor Moon che, convinta da una possibile perdita di peso reagisce, e grazie alla tiara distrugge i diademi e libera i malcapitati.

episodes.title: Profumo di trappola
episodes.synopsis: Usagi tries to convince her parents to let her adopt Luna, but her brother Shingo has a great disliking of Luna and slight ailurophobia. Later, a mysterious new pet store opens in town which is selling strange new creatures that put Shingo and everyone else who gets one into a hypnotic trance.

episodes.title: Musica e amore
episodes.synopsis: Usagi befriends Yusuke Amade, a jazz musician who is being followed by a Youma, and helps him confess to the woman he loves.

episodes.title: La strada del successo
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Naru both dream of becoming stars like Mikan Shiritori, a graduate from their school. When the girls hear that Mikan is holding a talent contest, they see their chance to achieve stardom.

episodes.title: Un mostro...ma di bravura
episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Guardians go to the Dream Land amusement park, where visitors have reportedly gone missing. The team splits into two groups: Usagi and Rei and Ami and Luna. But, much to Rei's frustration, Usagi is more focused on playing than finding the missing people.

episodes.title: Una lotta contro il tempo
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Ami go to the city to enjoy some shopping, where they find a clock store selling a clock that resembles Luna. Later that day, Usagi is happy to learn that her mother bought the exact same clock as a gift. But that night, the clocks from the store emit a strange light, making Usagi and the rest of Tokyo very impatient.

episodes.title: Il mistero dell'autobus scomparso
episodes.synopsis: Several people who take the bus near the Hikawa Shrine have gone missing. Usagi, Ami, and Luna decide to investigate by visiting the shrine. There, they meet Rei Hino, a shrine maiden with strong spiritual powers.

episodes.title: Il parco dei divertimenti
episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl is increasingly furious with Jadeite for his repeated failures; he starts up a theme park, but the general public notices the large number of disappearances. Usagi and Rei, who is now Sailor Mars, begin their combative friendship.

episodes.title: Una romantica crociera
episodes.synopsis: One of Queen Beryl's youma offers to help Jadeite with his wicked plans. Rei wins tickets on a luxury cruise ship and, since she has no boyfriend, asks Ami to accompany her. A jealous Usagi sneaks aboard after them.

episodes.title: La fine di Jack
episodes.synopsis: Usagi continues to be attracted to both Motoki and Tuxedo Mask. Threatened with Eternal Sleep if he should fail again, Jadeite confronts the Sailor Guardians at an airport.

episodes.title: Un nuovo nemico per Sailor Moon
episodes.synopsis: Nephrite is appointed as Jadeite's successor and begins selecting individual targets for energy, the first one being Naru's friend Rui.

episodes.title: Pericolo al parco
episodes.synopsis: Rei falls for Mamoru and persuades him to go on a date with her, whilst Nephrite targets the caretaker of a local park.

episodes.title: Fiori d'arancio
episodes.synopsis: Usagi decides to enter a homemade wedding dress contest, while her home economics teacher is targeted by Nephrite.

episodes.title: Tutti in posa
episodes.synopsis: Nephrite targets a gifted young photographer, while Usagi tries to achieve her dream of becoming a model.

episodes.title: Sam e le bambole
episodes.synopsis: Shingo upsets his friend Mika, an award-winning doll maker whose skills make her the next target for Nephrite's energy gathering.

episodes.title: Cara Sailor Moon
episodes.synopsis: Nephrite takes advantage of Sailor Moon's attraction to Tuxedo Mask by sending love letters to Usagi and her classmates. Naru falls in love with him in his civilian disguise, allowing him to drain a large amount of her energy.

episodes.title: Il fantasma
episodes.synopsis: Usagi, Ami, Rei, and Luna take a vacation in order to train, but the hotel they have booked is haunted by a strange phenomenon.

episodes.title: Cartoni animati in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: Nephrite uses his most powerful Youma to target an animator working for the new Sailor V movie.

episodes.title: Una festa movimentata
episodes.synopsis: Both Luna and Queen Beryl wonder if a visiting princess could be the one the Sailor Senshi has been looking for. Mamoru dreams he is Tuxedo Mask and a girl is asking him for the Silver Crystal. At the ball, Usagi gets her first kiss.

episodes.title: Un amore impossibile
episodes.synopsis: Zoisite decides to use Nephrite's recently discovered romantic feelings for Naru to manipulate him into handing over the Black Crystal to him.

episodes.title: Addio Nevius
episodes.synopsis: Still in love with Nephrite, Naru becomes an unwilling tool in the power struggle between Nephrite and Zoisite.

episodes.title: Sailor Jupiter
episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl partially awakens the evil entity Metalia and sends Zoisite and Kunzite to find the Seven Great Youma and their Rainbow Crystals. Meanwhile, the tomboyish Makoto Kino transfers into Usagi's school and falls for a crane-game whiz at the arcade.

episodes.title: La forza dell'amicizia
episodes.synopsis: Naru is still very depressed after Nephrite's death. Usagi and Umino decide to take her to Yokohama to cheer her up. There, a kindly priest is attacked by Zoisite. Mamoru realizes that he is Tuxedo Mask, and drops a locket on the ground, where Usagi finds it.

episodes.title: Un ammiratore di Amy
episodes.synopsis: Ami meets Ryo Urawa, a clairvoyant boy who has a crush on her. However, Urawa's power makes him aware that he will soon be transformed into a Youma by Zoisite.

episodes.title: Disegni d'amore
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Mamoru are asked to model for the reclusive painter Yumemi Yumeno, who is unexpectedly targeted by Zoisite.

episodes.title: La ragazza di Moran
episodes.synopsis: Makoto, like Usagi, develops a crush on Motoki. The two then decide to pursue him simultaneously, even after finding out that he has a girlfriend, who, meanwhile, is targeted by Zoisite and Kunzite.

episodes.title: Un mostro inatteso
episodes.synopsis: After fighting off an attack by Zoisite, Rei's grandfather takes on an apprentice and begins acting strangely.

episodes.title: Un fidanzato per Luna
episodes.synopsis: Luna discovers that she has an admirer, in the form of an overweight tomcat named Rhett Butler. Meanwhile, the Sailor Guardians and Zoisite compete for the last Rainbow Crystal.

episodes.title: Terrore al Luna Park
episodes.synopsis: Umino misinterprets Usagi's advice on seducing Naru, and begins to adopt the persona of Tuxedo Mask.

episodes.title: La quinta guerriera Sailor
episodes.synopsis: Zoisite disguises himself as Sailor Moon to lure Tuxedo Mask and the Sailor Guardians out into the open. The Dark Kingdom injures Tuxedo Mask's identity, but they are foiled by the appearance of Sailor Venus.

episodes.title: La Principessa della Luna
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru is forced to confront Zoisite in a duel over the Rainbow Crystals, but Usagi inadvertently becomes involved.

episodes.title: Il Regno della Luna
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Mamoru remember their former lives as Princess Serenity and Prince Endymion. The Dark Kingdom kidnaps the injured Mamoru, but Queen Beryl executes Zoisite for his attempt to kill him. Luna and Artemis tell the Sailor Guardians about their tragic past.

episodes.title: Un nemico inaspettato
episodes.synopsis: Minako tries to cheer Usagi up by taking her to a hair salon, leading to the discovery that Tuxedo Mask is still alive, but now very different.

episodes.title: Lezioni di bon ton
episodes.synopsis: Determined to become more like the princess she is supposed to be, Usagi decides to enlist in Countess Rose's Princess Seminar.

episodes.title: Avventura sulla neve
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her friends visit the Moonlight Course skiing resort, unaware that Kunzite has sabotaged the Moon Princess Contest in order to unmask Sailor Moon.

episodes.title: Lezione di pattinaggio
episodes.synopsis: After discovering that the Moon Princess was once known for her graceful ice skating, Kunzite tries to use this information to trap Sailor Moon. The best skater among the girls, however, turns out to be Makoto. Tuxedo Mask appears to help them, but only because he does not agree with Kunzite's method of involving bystanders.

episodes.title: Lo spirito del lago
episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her family visit a hot springs resort, while Endymion is sent to resurrect an ancient legendary monster.

episodes.title: Il ritorno dei sette malvagi
episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl orders the seven people gathered who had carried Rainbow Crystals, intending to combine them into one huge youma. Ami is determined to protect Urawa. Sailor Moon tries to heal Endymion.

episodes.title: Un triste ricordo
episodes.synopsis: Kunzite probes Sailor V's connection with the Sailor Senshi by targeting Katarina, an old acquaintance of Minako's.

episodes.title: Litigio fasullo
episodes.synopsis: On orders from Queen Beryl, Kunzite and his Youma investigate the rumors of a rift between Sailor Moon and the other Inner Sailor Guardians, who seem to want both the mystical Moon Stick and the Silver Crystal for themselves.

episodes.title: Un viaggio nel tempo
episodes.synopsis: A blast of energy sends the Guardians to the ruined Moon Kingdom, where they meet a hologram of Queen Serenity and learn about their past. Luna and Artemis find the entrance to the Dark Kingdom. Kunzite attacks, but is finally defeated by Sailor Moon.

episodes.title: La resa dei conti
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Kunzite, regaining their past memories, and discovering the Dark Kingdom's hideout the Sailor Senshi head for the enemy, but they must prepare for the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: La vittoria delle guerriere Sailor
episodes.synopsis: With her friends killed, Sailor Moon is transported inside the Dark Kingdom to face Queen Beryl and the brainwashed Prince Endymion.

info.title: Battle Spirits - Dan il guerriero Rosso (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dan Bashin è un giovane appassionato del gioco di carte "Battle Spirits", la cui abilità gli è valso il titolo di "Clash King". Un giorno, una misteriosa ragazza dai capelli verdi, colpita dal suo talento, lo trasporta nel mondo di "Grand Rolo", dove le controversie vengono risolte con duelli di carte...

Nonostante tutto continua a presentarsi a lavoro mettendo in gioco la propria vita. Yasen, un goffo supereroe alieno, ha deciso di aiutarla e ogni giorno tenta con grande entusiasmo di trovare un modo per salvarla... peccato che non riesca ad essere molto d'aiuto.

episodes.title: A ciascuno la sua promessa
episodes.synopsis: Dopo svariate morti, Subaru ce l'ha fatta. La Balena Bianca è stata abbattuta e l'Arcivescovo dell'Accidia sconfitto. Rem, tuttavia...

episodes.title: Il prossimo luogo
episodes.synopsis: Subaru ed Emilia tornano al villaggio di Arlam per fare rapporto a Roswaal e discutere sul da farsi. Qui, però, trovano il villaggio deserto...

episodes.title: Un incontro a lungo atteso
episodes.synopsis: Sulla strada per il Santuario, Subaru si ritrova senza volerlo invitato a un ricevimento fra streghe tenuto da Echidna, la Strega dell'Avidità.

episodes.title: Genitori e figli
episodes.synopsis: Subaru è nella sua stanza. O almeno, così sembra, ma qualcosa continua a non tornare. I suoi genitori, dal canto loro, non sembrano aver notato nulla.

episodes.title: Un passo avanti
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver raggiunto un posto da cui non può più tornare, Subaru si rende conto di quanto gli è stato dato e di quanto poco possa fare per ripagarlo.

episodes.title: Il vangelo della fanciulla
episodes.synopsis: Dopo essere stato ucciso da Elsa, Subaru si risveglia nel cimitero nell'istante successivo a quando ha superato la prova del suo passato.

episodes.title: Amici
episodes.synopsis: Dietro la porta che doveva condurlo da Rem, Subaru trova Beatrice. Ricordandone il silenzio durante l'attacco di Elsa, Subaru le chiede spiegazioni.

episodes.title: Il valore della vita
episodes.synopsis: Subaru è stato catturato e imprigionato da Garfiel, ma Otto corre a salvarlo e gli spiega che hanno una sola occasione di uscire dalla Barriera...

episodes.title: Ti amo ti amo ti amo ti amo ti amo ti amo
episodes.synopsis: Dopo essere stato divorato da creature sconosciute, Subaru si risveglia accanto a Emilia, quasi impazzito. In quel momento, Echidna si rifà viva...

episodes.title: So com'è fatto l'inferno
episodes.synopsis: Subaru esce dal cimitero e si ritrova avvolto da una coltre di oscurità. Garfiel interviene a salvarlo dall'arrivo della Strega.

episodes.title: Il sapore della morte
episodes.synopsis: Subaru corre alla tenuta per cercare di capire cosa succede, mentre Frederica e Petra raggiungono il villaggio di Arlam per proteggerlo da Elsa.

episodes.title: Un tè in compagnia delle streghe
episodes.synopsis: Subaru si risveglia a fianco di Emilia. Stavolta è deciso a salvare non solo lei, ma tutti coloro che si trovano nel Santuario e alla tenuta.

episodes.title: I suoni che fanno venire voglia di piangere
episodes.synopsis: Una serie di visioni colpisce Subaru, durante la seconda parte della Prova. È la voce della persona che ama a scuoterlo e spronarlo a rialzarsi.

info.title: Armored Trooper Votoms
info.synopsis: Coinvolto in una missione illegale per rubare segreti militari, il soldato corazzato Chirico Cuvie è in fuga dal suo stesso esercito. Lasciato a morire dai suoi comandanti traditori, Chirico si dirige verso Uoodo City, un alveare di criminali e rifugiati, dove avrà bisogno di tutte le sue abilità affinate sul campo di battaglia per pter sopravvivere. Spinto dall'immagine di una donna misteriosa il cui destino è legato al suo, Chirico inizia una ricerca che scuoterà le fondamenta dell'intera galassia!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Chirico Cuvie demands answers when his unit opens fires on their forces during a top-secret mission, but his superior officer stonewalls him. What is going on?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Months after the mission that changed his life forever, Chirico hides in the wretched hive known as Uoodo. What recourse does he have when he is enslaved by a local gang?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Chirico has plans for the ruined Scopedog he found in the junkyard. Will this be the opportunity he needs to turn his luck around?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Recognizing Chirico's expertise as a pilot, Gotho offers him an opportunity to make his fortune in the underground VOTOMS gladiatorial sport known as Battling.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Chirico is caught by powerful people who believe the soldier was sent to Uoodo under orders. As they torture him for information, Chirico's allies plan a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Reflecting upon the events thus far, Chirico leaves to face the chief of police. His allies plan a daring heist without him.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Rumors swirl of the police using a city-wide sweep as cover for a mysterious transport. Intrigued, Chirico investigates.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The crew celebrates, but Chirico wishes no part in the spoils. While the police react, another player watches from the shadows.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Chirico faces the wrath of the police alone. Enraged, Coconna demands that the crew return to help their friend.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The police adopt a scorched earth policy in their attempts to flush Chirico and his allies out. Forced to run, the four take drastic measures to save their own lives.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Prototype defies a direct order to engage Chirico in combat. The police chief and Borough attempt to discover why while the AT pilot dominates the battle.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Chirico and the Prototype are discussing their situation when the police discover their location. Borough proposes that Battling pilots chase after them.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The military occupies Uoodo and demands the surrender of police forces. Chief Iskui is ordered by his superior to buy time so the Prototype can be smuggled out of the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Three months after the events on Uoodo, a new chapter unfolds as Chirico finds himself on the front lines as a mercenary in the war-torn kingdom of Kummen.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Captain Kan Yu's assistance arrives just in time and Chirico is questioned for his battlefield decision. A PS is a deadly opponent, so what are their options when facing one?

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: The mercenaries fend off a guerrilla raid, but Pol is shocked when he recognizes one of the attackers. Chirico discovers Pol's connection to the Kummen army.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Chirico miscalculated, and the enemy was not who he thought it was. Despite this, he's still determined to find answers, and the two soldiers clash.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Chirico's been found, but his miraculous survival causes the suspicious Captain Kan Yu to accuse him of switching sides and demands his interrogation.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: A Melkian officer plans to inspect the front lines when the Veela unleash their assault on EX-10 and Niitan. Vanilla refuses to abandon the club despite Coconna's urging.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Chirico reflects upon his previous adventure and the events that led to his reunion with Fyana in Uoodo.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Chirico is put in charge of an operation against enemy headquarters. Kan Yu objects, believing he should be in command instead.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Kan Yu is criticized for his actions and ordered to follow a new strategy as everyone's plans seemingly depend on Chirico.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Fyana seizes an opportunity and flees into the jungle. An injured Borough is enraged when he realizes that Ypsilon has gone after her and orders the unthinkable.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Loyalties are tested after Chirico rewards his friends with the truth after they save both him and Fyana from an ambush.

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: A man left for dead refuses to die, despite everything the jungle throws at him. Meanwhile, Chirico's group plans their assault.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Vanilla must join a massive assault, despite Gotho and Coconna's concerns. With the forces converging on the palace, is the war finally coming to an end?

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: Three figures muse over the status of the war as fighting rages on the planet below. Chirico confronts Borough and demands answers regarding the PS.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Before the next adventure begins, Chirico recalls painful memories of his past exploits in Uoodo.

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana may have escaped Kummen, but they now find themselves in an undisclosed and seemingly abandoned location. For what purpose are they there?

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana attempt to thwart their attackers, but they are too numerous. Does the enemy have good reasons for its actions?

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: The captain is done playing and vows to capture Chirico and Fyana. A distraction is all it takes for Chirico's AT to suffer critical damage.

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: Chirico's condition deteriorates, and Fyana must take drastic measures if she wishes to save him.

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana fight at a disadvantage against Ypsilon. How will they turn the tide when Ypsilon's hatred for Chirico drives him to a single-minded purpose?

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: A brawl with a scavenger gang leads to a reunion with an old friend. Meanwhile, a captain must decide whether to continue a mission or pursue Chirico.

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: The ATs stare each other down in grim anticipation of the coming battle. When the Balarant suddenly attack, everyone must scramble for their lives.

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: The trio is alone in the desert and low on oxygen. Zophie has not forgotten, nor has she forgiven. But to survive, she may need Chirico's assistance regardless.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: Repairs on the AT continue, but the Balarant forces are quickly approaching. Chirico wants his friends to save themselves, but they have other plans.

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: Ypsilon and Chirico are destined to fight over and over. But when they are both trapped by debris, can Ypsilon set aside his hatred in the interest of mutual survival?

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: With the immediate danger behind them, Chirico and Ypsilon prepare for their sworn rematch. Will they finally be able to settle things once and for all?

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: Time is a flat circle. Chirico remembers how he escaped from Kummen alongside Fyana, only to end up on a mysterious warship.

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: With his ship crashed, Chirico has no choice but to venture into the hostile deserts of Quent if he wishes to continue his mission.

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: The Society no longer underestimates Chirico and considers him a legitimate threat. Meanwhile, Chirico and Shako must brave the desert on their travels.

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: The twins decide to make planetfall. Meanwhile, Chirico requests entrance to the Quentman village.

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: There can be no more room for doubt in the Society's mind: Quent contains a trove of advanced technology. What will be their next move after this discovery?

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: The events on Quent captures the attention of another party, which deploys its forces in response. Chirico and Shako explore the ruins beneath the planet's surface.

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: As Gilgamesh and Balarant forces prepare for battle, the Society wonders how they can use this to their advantage. Unless something changes, Quent will turn into a warzone.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: The battle rages over the planet. To the victor goes Quent's secrets. Chirico's friends escape in a stolen Gilgamesh ship but are quickly intercepted by the Balarant.

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: Onboard a ship not under their control, its passengers can only wait as it ventures closer to an object that is clearly no moon. What awaits all of them inside?

episodes.title: Episodio 49
episodes.synopsis: A 3,000-year-old truth unites the warring Gilgamesh and Balarant into a single, vengeful army. Meanwhile, what are the implications for Wiseman's plans with Chirico?

episodes.title: Episodio 50
episodes.synopsis: A failed mutiny solidifies Chirico's control. The joint Gilgamesh/Balarant fleet devises ways to fight Wiseman. As forces converge, a question burns: How can one stop a god?

episodes.title: Episodio 51
episodes.synopsis: History is filled with men who sacrificed everything in pursuit of power. Fyana refuses to let her love be one of them. Is Chirico truly willing to make everyone his enemy?

episodes.title: Episodio 52
episodes.synopsis: The road was long and hard-fought but in the end, a choice will be made. That choice will determine the fate of the entire galaxy.

episodes.title: Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon
episodes.synopsis: In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he decides to pursue his abandoned dream of joining the Force... when he suddenly transforms into the powerful "Kaiju No. 8." With help from his junior colleague Reno Ichikawa, Kafka hides his identity while striving towards his life-long dream of passing the Defense Force exam and standing at Mina's side. But when a mysterious intelligent Kaiju attacks a Defense Force base, Kafka faces a crucial decision in a desperate situation...

info.title: Tokyo Daigaku Monogatari
info.synopsis: Basato sul manga di lunga durata di Tatsuya Egawa (Golden Boy). Racconta la storia di Murakami Naoki, studente dell’ultimo anno di liceo, che si innamora di Mizuno Haruka mentre si preparano agli esami di ammissione all’università.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sano takes Naoki to see a tennis game. They are both attracted to Haruka, but Naoki tries to talk Sano out of pursuing her.  Naoki ends up asking her out, and she says yes. Haruka resolves to go to Tokyo U. Naoki is skeptical, but helps her study. He gets distracted by Eri though, and thinks too much.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The first part is a dream sequence. Naoki is going to Waseda, living with Maki, while studying for Tokyo U.'s entrance exam. Maki tells him she's pregnant. They fight. He goes to find Eri, but she's moved on. He finally manages to pass the entrance exam, and goes to find Haruka.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Milky Holmes have been neglecting their roles as detectives to tend to a vegetable farm they have been working on, which irritates Henriette who wants them to work on regaining their Toys. Noticing Henriette's depression, the Gentlemen Thieves take it upon themselves to get revenge on Milky Holmes by wrecking their vegetable farm, though this ends up evoking a murderous rage within them. After Milky Holmes are reminded about their roles as detectives, the matter is settled following a few explosions and Henriette's order to destroy the farm.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: As Milky Holmes laments the loss of their farm, Hercule notices their Toys have returned, with the others oblivious to the fact. Hercule is later given a strange painting from her part-time job, which peaks the interest of a wealthy man as it reminds him of his long lost wife, offering a large sum which Nero accepts. However, a wind blows it away, leading to a rampant chase throughout town, with everyone besides Hercule oblivious of their use of Toys. The soon find the painting underneath a beached whale, which Hercule manages to lift off using her Toys, launching it into a pirate ship that held the man's long lost wife hostage. After eating some sushi, which Hercule forces Nero to use her money to pay for, the girls return home to learn from Henriette that the Holmes Detective Academy may be shutting down, the shock of which causes them to lose their Toys again. Hercule reminds the others of their duties as detectives and together they start thinking of a way to save the academy.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Milky Holmes decide to go explore the Hakkei Prison Island to find a way to save the academy, but they are captured and imprisoned on arrival. Meanwhile, Henriette and the Gentlemen Thieves have also infiltrated the island in search of a legendary treasure. After hearing about the treasure from an old man, Henriette, along with Milky Holmes, stage a breakout, but end up falling into traps by the prison guard. However, they manage to find their way out and soon find the treasure is a single flower which, when removed, reduces the prison into a pile of sea cucumbers, only to later realise they had set a bunch of criminals into the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: As Milky Holmes have trouble sleeping together, they unconcsciously activate their Toys to interfere with each other's dreams.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: As reports come in of a flasher in the city, Milky Holmes encounters a girl named Coron from Osaka, who gets them to help her investigate the culprit. The girls come to suspect the Gentlemen Thieves and confront them with an odd method that ultimately fails, whilst Stone River comes at Hercule, suspecting her to be the flasher. Finding herself in a strange part of town, Hercule is targeted by a flasher but manages to knock her out, revealing her to be Coron, whose real name is Pō. Wanting to experience the freedom of being naked, the others decide to take her to a bathhouse, whilst G4 capture the true culprit.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: As Milky Holmes encounter G4, who are searching on the Enoden Express train for a terrorist planning to bomb a statue, they decide to help look for the culprit after Kokoro is mysteriously knocked out. After a series of bizarre events, they discover the culprit is the conductor who is a fan of Kokoro and wanted to meet her. As the mystery behind Kokoro being knocked out is solved, Milky Holmes takes pride in their achievement until they accidentally blow up the statue themselves.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: As Henriette's patience with Milky Holmes finally snaps, she leaks to the news that Arsene is planning to destroy Holmes Detective Agency. Later that night as everyone is gathered outside, Arsene appears, using her illusion Toys to make everyone fight each other. As she announces her plans to leave Yokohama, the Gentleman Thieves fight against her to stop her, but to no avail. She defeats the thieves and proceeds to destroy the academy, leaving Milky Holmes and everyone else behind.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: After spending the night searching for Henriette, the girls discover that the Academy is being shut down and all its residents being transferred elsewhere except for Milky Holmes. As both Milky Holmes and the Gentleman Thieves start to lose their grip on reality from missing Henriette, Cordelia unleashes a strange power that traps everyone in an illusion. Kamaboko manages to get Stone River out of the illusion, who in turn gets help from Hercule to rescue everyone else. As the Gentlemen Thieves part ways, Milky Holmes decides to start up a new Holmes Detective Academy.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Annoyed that the other G4 members are having a day off whilst she herself is stuck with paperwork, Kokoro enlists the help of Milky Holmes to annoy them. When they soon figure out her plan, she instead has Milky Holmes pose as the Gentlemen Thieves to steal a case from a group of policemen and lure G4 into action. As G4 discover the policemen are actually thieves, Milky Holmes discover a captured singer inside the case and are praised for her rescue. Meanwhile, Mori steals an interesting artifact.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Mori tells Milky Holmes they may be able to regain their Toys by finding an artifact called Pandora's Pot underneath the ruins of Holmes Detective Academy. However, what they actually unleash are all the evil Toys that Sherlock Holmes had sealed away long ago. As Mori makes off with one of the Toys, the rest are absorbed by the lard obsessed Buta, who vows revenge against Milky Holmes from keeping him from his lard. Gaining incredibly power from the Toys, Buta starts to steal all the lard and fat in Yokohama, causing everyone to become all dried up and full of static electricity. G4 and the Gentlemen Thieves stand against Buta, but he uses a powerful Toys that turns everyone into no-good idiots. However, Milky Holmes are unaffected, since they are already idiots, so Buta uses all his lard to transform into a new form.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Wanting to create a world made entirely of lard, Buta attempts to steal the Legendary Lard, but Milky Holmes stands in his way. Meanwhile, Arséne, who is in London, encounters Sonia, who attempts to convince her that Milky Holmes haven't lost their way. As Buta manages to retrieve the Legendary Lard and starts absorbing lard from across the globe, Milky Holmes stand up to them and regain their Toys and work together to fight against Buta. Undeterred, Buta fuses himself with the lard he has amassed to evolve into a new form, but Arséne manages to get herself across the globe to stop him, allowing Milky Holmes to use Arsene Lupin's straw to defeat Buta and return the lard to its rightful place. As snow falls over Yokohama, Arséne reunites with the Gentlemen Thieves.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: ヨコハマへの帰還を果たしたアルセーヌは、３カードとともに怪盗帝国の活動を再開し、一回り成長したに違いないミルキィホームズたちとの邂逅を心待ちにする。一方、何とか探偵博のマスコットガールになろうと奮闘するミルキィホームズ。そんな中、マスコットガールの審査を持ち前の強運で勝ちあがっていくシャロ。いよいよ最終審査を迎えるシャロの前にもう一人の最終候補者が現れるが・・・。

info.title: Labyrinth Of Flames
info.synopsis: Galan è un giovane ragazzo russo, grande fan dei samurai, il suo desiderio è diventarlo egli stesso. La sua amica Natsu gli dona una spada ed il ragazzo ne è entusiasta. Peccato che Natsu sia una principessa dalle lontane origini giapponesi e la spada, se accettata, implica una promessa di matrimonio. Non solo, la sacra spada è anche la chiave per accedere ad un immenso tesoro, nascosto in Russia dagli antenati di Natsu. Galan si ritroverà a dover proteggere la famiglia di Natsu da due ladri che intendono rivelare il segreto che è rimasto tale per circa trecento anni.

info.title: Ultraviolet: Code 044
info.synopsis: 044 è il nome in codice della soldatessa più forte delle truppe governative; in particolare si distingue dagli altri in combattimento perché è capace di usare la manipolazione genetica attraverso un virus. Il costo per questa sua capacità, però, è una vita molto breve. La prossima missione delle truppe governative è quella di distruggere una squadra assetata di sangue, Phage, e il suo leader King. Durante la battaglia, la ragazza si scontra Fago, ma stranamente Luka si scopre incapace di ucciderlo. Accusata di tradimento sarà costretta a fuggire proprio assieme a Fago.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: 044 poses as a loyal member of the Phage forum in order to eliminate an upper class member of the society. Her activities are overseen by the eccentric Daxus II, of the Central Government. Though as powerful as she is, 044's lifespan seems to be shortening and as such, begins to wonder about her own existence.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: 044 is ordered to infiltrate the assembly of Phages in the Neo Tokyo sewer system to find their leader, King. There she finds Luka, a young man who has made a promise to kill her. They fight, however, before 044 can kill him, he chooses his own fate by diving into the sewer. In this encounter something deep within 044 is awakened and thus she rescues Luka, whom she was to kill.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Now that 044 has found love, she has a reason to live.She betrays her organization and must find Luka before the central government hunts her down.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: After escaping into the sewers of Neo Tokyo, 044 is discovered by bounty hunters. She discovers that not only is Daxus II after her, but the Phage, having placed a bounty for her head, are as well. On top of that, she finds the strange need to reconcile with Luka and goes to Matilda's Clinic only to find that things may not be as easy as she thought.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: A group of Phages infiltrate Matilda's Clinic and take away Luka. The police along with the SBCU (Special Battle Clone Unit) arrive soon after the Phages.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: 044 and Garcia take refuge in a ship, transporting them to a planet which promises to keep her real identiy hidden. As she attempts to hide a man reveals a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 044 and Garcia discover Sakuza's mysterious past. All the while, 044 is once again made aware of her dwindling lifespan.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Daxus II arrives at the Coffin of Despair and begins operation to root out 044 and Sakuza.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 044 is forced to flee into the abadoned mining tunnels with Zakusa and Garcia. Zakusa rallies his clone soldiers to take on Daxus II and help 044 escape.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: After losing the clone soldiers, 044 and Garcia are forced to rely on a miracle, Zakusa's legacy. Rescued by King, they must find a place where Daxus II can't find them.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Escaping certain death, 044 and Garcia find refuge. They must flee the White Planet with the subdued Luka to save themselves.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Luka decides he must save King in order to be forgiven. Garcia gets closer to locating the woman behind the voice and it's only a matter of time before 044 must face her.

info.title: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
info.synopsis: L'anime è incentrato su Botan Kamiina, una ventenne nel suo primo anno di college, che diventa più audace e dice cose sorprendenti quando si ubriaca.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: At a festival with her housemates, Botan runs off to find Ibuki, who is enjoying a highball on a bench alone.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Botan tries shochu for the first time with Kanade. Ibuki takes Botan to a boutique that serves alcohol.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Botan invites Ibuki on a trip to a private hot spring bath, where she musters liquid courage to ask a favor.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Botan and Ibuki sneak away at a shrine to shop for liquor, while the other dorm residents do some sightseeing.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Botan visits a bar for the first time. Kanade makes strawberry-infused whisky to give as a gift to Ibuki.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Botan and Ibuki visit a limestone cavern with Chin-Lan, the new dorm resident, and go drinking afterwards.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Ibuki, Kanade, and Chin-Lan climb Mt. Buko. Botan and Ibuki take a trip to Tokyo to watch a planetarium show.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Yaeka invites Akane, Botan, and Chin-Lan to a bathhouse. Botan and Ibuki go drinking by the riverside.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Ibuki, Kanade, and Chin-Lan hold a drinking session in the dorm. Botan and Ibuki go on a glamping trip.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Kanade and the others take a trip to the museum. Akane and Yaeka reminisce over a shared song from their past.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Kanade and Chin-Lan discuss movies over drinks at an izakaya. Botan visits her first hookah lounge with Akane.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Kanade and Chin-Lan exchange Christmas gifts. Botan and Ibuki take a hot spring trip to Echigo-Yuzawa.

info.title: One Piece: Episode of Merry - La storia di un'altra compagna
info.synopsis: Mentre stanno facendo la revisione periodica della Mini Merry, Brook chiede a Usopp se esiste anche una versione più grande che ha ispirato la barchetta. Così il cecchino inizia a raccontare la storia della Going Merry e di come ha salvato la ciurma di Cappello di paglia da una situazione critica a Enies Lobby, l'isola giudiziaria del Governo Mondiale.

info.title: Let's Go Kaikigumi
info.synopsis: In un giorno molto particolare, un giovane codardo di cui non viene mai rivelato il nome, incontra Mechako, la leader dell'organizzazione "Kaikigumi". Questa misteriosa associazione si occupa di fantasmi e altre creature soprannaturali che spaventano gli esseri umani. In un modo del tutto inaspettato, il protagonista si ritrova coinvolto nella rinascita della Kaikigumi, dando il via a una serie di fenomeni bizzarri che iniziano ad accadere intorno a lui.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: A high school boy terrified of ghosts meets a girl in a sailor uniform—the boss of the Kaiki-gumi!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Mechako brought an ominous-looking Japanese doll that was left behind by the previous boss of Kaikigumi.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Mechako is feeling off, and that is because of the talismans of a sketchy medium.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Doppelgänger uses impersonation to get Mechako's attention, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: As the curse regresses Shurako into a child, she goes after Mechako's doll.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: A face lump possesses a high school girl's leg and refuses to leave her alone.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: As bizarre events continued to unfold, people began vanishing across town in alarming numbers.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Winter arrives. As Doppel plots revenge against Shurako, a Snow Woman in a swimsuit appears before him.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Fearless Mechako grows curious about nightmares and decides to experience one for herself, and...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Mechako sets out to create the ultimate ghost using what she learned about people's fears, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: With Mechako no longer around, a mysterious girl appears before Shurako, Doppel, and others...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The mysterious girl who attacked Shurako and the cursed doll finally appears before Mechako!

info.title: Ghost Meets Gal!
info.synopsis: Spin-off di Cardfight!! Vanguard incentrato su due ragazze che aspirano a diventare idol.

episodes.title: La quiete prima della tempesta
episodes.synopsis: Un ex edgerunner sull'orlo della cyberpsicosi e un sopravvissuto solitario dal passato frammentato iniziano le loro storie ai lati opposti di Night City.

episodes.title: Dammi un'altra possibilità
episodes.synopsis: Una richiesta disperata di salvare un'adolescente ribelle espone Weak di nuovo al pericolo. D lega con un giovane cinefilo e ricordi dolorosi alimentano la sua sete di vendetta.
Weak cerca di salvare Talia da un intervento rischioso, ma lo scontro finisce in tragedia. D e Roman scoprono un chip instabile che scatena il caos.

episodes.title: Uno, nessuno, centomila
episodes.synopsis: D si ritrova con abilità che non comprende appieno e usa il potere di Capri per infiltrarsi in una struttura di ricerca dell'Arasaka. Talia e Weak raggiungono un'intesa.

episodes.title: Non lasciarmi
episodes.synopsis: Un gesto impulsivo trascina Talia in una spirale terrificante. L'ossessione di D per la vendetta raggiunge un nuovo e inquietante livello di violenza.

episodes.title: Tutto intorno, solo odio
episodes.synopsis: D si trasforma in un giustiziere contro le multinazionali e chiede a Roman di filmare ogni sua mossa. Weak indaga su una tecnologia in grado di trasferire un'anima digitalizzata.

episodes.title: Con te fino agli abissi
episodes.synopsis: Le condizioni di Talia peggiorano drasticamente sotto la supervisione di Capri. D riallaccia i rapporti con una vecchia amica. Weak e Avida cercano una cura miracolosa.

episodes.title: L'amore di una madre
episodes.synopsis: Una rivolta esplode per le strade mentre D scava nel passato oscuro del progetto Capricorn. Avida e Weak lottano contro il tempo per il futuro di Talia.

episodes.title: Ti voglio solo per me
episodes.synopsis: Omi e D spariscono e Kiril prende Talia in custodia. Kyoko porta avanti il progetto Capricorn con risultati terrificanti.

episodes.title: E poi tutti tornarono a casa
episodes.synopsis: Un'agghiacciante metamorfosi trasforma la città in una zona di guerra, culminando in uno scontro esplosivo.
